setup.name: create_connector
setup.description: Create the connector in the Kei console with the provider's setup fields (schemas/connector-setup.v1.json). Secrets go to the console-connected secret manager; the connector keeps only its credential_ref.

setup.name: declare_capabilities
setup.description: Declare the capabilities the connector exposes. ABAC policy decides who may use them.

verify.name: invoke_read
verify.description: Run one read through the runtime adapter.
